-- keep the complaints: the zipper and the strap
SELECT body FROM (VALUES
    ('Arrived a day early. Thank you!'),
    ('The zipper broke the first time I used it.'),
    ('Does this come in blue?'),
    ('The strap snapped on day two.')) AS t(body)
WHERE thinkthen_decide('{"decide": "Is this a complaint?"}', body);
